package.name: bsn_bdd
package.description: The BDD suite, living in features/ rather than inside any one package because its scenarios exercise central_hub, sensor, patient and system_monitor together. The .feature specs sit at the root, their pytest-bdd step definitions in steps/, and test/ holds launch_testing harnesses that bring up a per-feature ROS2 stack (see central_hub/launch/*.py) and run steps/test_*.py against it, so `colcon test` can run the suite without a manual `ros2 launch` + `pytest` first.
